# Get to Know Professional Lines


## **3 Reasons to Send Us Your Next Professional Lines Risk**


You may know our[Professional Lines teams](https://www.kinsaleins.com/products/professional-lines/) for fast responses, reliable excess solutions, and broad appetite. Here’s what else we’d like you to know, plus a few questions to ask to learn even more!


### **We’re more than a last resort.**


Yes, we’re known for the tough ones. But we quote simple and complex risks alike, so bring us in early.
***Ask us:** “Which accounts should I be sending you first?”*


### **We can build wording around the account.**


If one term is the sticking point, tell us. The first quote is just the start of the conversation.
***Ask us:** “Where do you have room to customize?”*


### **We’re making it easier to work with us.**


New products, broader terms, and now, a dedicated underwriting contact for every office.
***Ask us:** “Who’s my dedicated underwriter?”*


### **Let’s get the conversation started**


Connect with a division manager to find your assigned underwriter, discuss an account, or set up an appetite refresher. Not sure who fits? Email any of us and we’ll point you to the right person!
